policy: Entries are exact guarded compatibility boundaries. Production reachability is calculated from the recursive Authority entry graph and is never inferred from directory placement.

entries.reason: Operators may run frozen Legacy compatibility commands, but Authority CLI commands do not cross this guard.
entries.removal_condition: All frozen import/export and compatibility operations have PostgreSQL replacements and their retention window has expired.

entries.reason: The module is a fail-closed selector boundary; it does not authorize Legacy storage or silent fallback in Authority mode.
entries.removal_condition: Compatibility model adapters are retired after all supported provider paths use the Authority provider boundary.
transitive_paths: Authority entrypoint -> provider/model router -> novel_forge.model_adapters.guarded [guard boundary]

entries.allowed_runtime: offline audit and architecture test only
entries.reason: The scanner reads Legacy implementation metadata to measure parity; it is not a business read or write authority.
entries.removal_condition: Legacy parity inventory is retired or rewritten against an immutable archived source manifest.

entries.allowed_runtime: explicit migration command with frozen snapshot input
entries.reason: This is the sole audited Legacy data ingestion boundary. It imports immutable snapshots into PostgreSQL and quarantines unsafe records; it is never a live production read fallback.
entries.removal_condition: All retained snapshots are migrated or formally abandoned and the migration retention policy permits deletion.
